import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int N, T, W;
    static char[][] B;
    static int[] D1, D2;
    static final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static final int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int idx(int r, int c) {
        return r * W + c;
    }

    static void bfs_from_z(Pos z) {
        D1 = new int[W * W];
        Arrays.fill(D1, -1);
        ArrayList<Integer> q = new ArrayList<>();
        int head = 0;
        D1[idx(z.r, z.c)] = 0;
        q.add(idx(z.r, z.c));
        while (head < q.size()) {
            int cur = q.get(head++);
            int r = cur / W, c = cur % W;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                int ni = idx(nr, nc);
                if (D1[ni] != -1) continue;
                D1[ni] = D1[cur] + 1;
                q.add(ni);
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs_from_scientist(Pos s) {
        D2 = new int[W * W];
        Arrays.fill(D2, -1);
        ArrayList<Integer> q = new ArrayList<>();
        int head = 0;
        D2[idx(s.r, s.c)] = 0;
        q.add(idx(s.r, s.c));
        while (head < q.size()) {
            int cur = q.get(head++);
            int r = cur / W, c = cur % W;
            if (D1[cur] >= 0 && D2[cur] >= D1[cur]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                int ni = idx(nr, nc);
                if (D2[ni] != -1) continue;
                if (D1[ni] >= 0 && D1[ni] < D2[cur] + 1) continue;
                D2[ni] = D2[cur] + 1;
                q.add(ni);
            }
        }
    }

    static int max_flow(int s, int t, int[][] cap) {
        int n = cap.length;
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            int[] pre = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            ArrayList<Integer> q = new ArrayList<>();
            int head = 0;
            pre[s] = s;
            q.add(s);
            while (head < q.size() && pre[t] == -1) {
                int u = q.get(head++);
                for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                    if (pre[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                        pre[v] = u;
                        q.add(v);
                        if (v == t) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[t] == -1) break;
            int add = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = pre[v])
                add = Math.min(add, cap[pre[v]][v]);
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = pre[v]) {
                cap[pre[v]][v] -= add;
                cap[v][pre[v]] += add;
            }
            flow += add;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static class Pos {
        int r, c;
        Pos(int rr, int cc) {
            r = rr;
            c = cc;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        W = N + 2;

        B = new char[W][W];
        for (int r = 0; r < W; ++r) Arrays.fill(B[r], '#');
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) B[r][c] = line.charAt(c - 1);
        }
        char[][] B1 = new char[W][W];
        for (int r = 0; r < W; ++r) B1[r] = B[r].clone();

        char[][] B2 = new char[W][W];
        for (int r = 0; r < W; ++r) Arrays.fill(B2[r], '#');
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) B2[r][c] = line.charAt(c - 1);
        }

        ArrayList<Pos> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Pos> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = null;
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                char ch = B[r][c];
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    if (ch > '0') scientists.add(new Pos(r, c));
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    z = new Pos(r, c);
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
                char ch2 = B2[r][c];
                if (ch2 >= '0' && ch2 <= '9' && ch2 > '0')
                    capsules.add(new Pos(r, c));
            }
        }

        bfs_from_z(z);

        int nS = scientists.size();
        int nC = capsules.size();
        int SRC = 0;
        int SINK = nS + nC + 1;
        int[][] cap = new int[SINK + 1][SINK + 1];
        final int INF = 98765432;

        for (int i = 0; i < nS; ++i) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            cap[SRC][i + 1] += B1[s.r][s.c] - '0';
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < nC; ++j) {
            Pos c = capsules.get(j);
            cap[nS + j + 1][SINK] += B2[c.r][c.c] - '0';
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < nS; ++i) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            bfs_from_scientist(s);
            for (int j = 0; j < nC; ++j) {
                Pos c = capsules.get(j);
                int ci = idx(c.r, c.c);
                if (D2[ci] >= 0 && D2[ci] <= T)
                    cap[i + 1][nS + j + 1] = INF;
            }
        }

        pw.println(max_flow(SRC, SINK, cap));
        pw.flush();
    }
}
